necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to evaluate the efficacy of current rate control management. This service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical indications of syncope and presyncope associated with diagnosis codes R55, I48.91, and I49.5.
